description.value: Functional and structural images were reoriented, slice-time corrected, motion corrected, coregistered, segmented, normalized to Montreal Neurological Institute space, and smoothed.

spans.text: The preprocessing pipeline consisted of the manual reorientation of the structural and functional images so that the anterior commissure lay on the origin ([0, 0, 0]-coordinate), slice timing correction, head motion correction, coregistration of the functional image to the structural file, segmentation, normalization to Montreal Neurological Institute space, and smoothing using an 8-m Gaussian kernel to minimize noise and residual differences in gyral anatomy.
